top_signals.title: Oil Gains, Treasuries Hold Losses Before Jobs Data: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Oil rose as prospects for a lasting agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive. Treasuries held their losses ahead of the key US jobs data report.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
